career_hosts derives careers/jobs hosts.why: fixed: the case passes a URL (https://www.acme.co.uk/about); root_domain now cuts a URL to its host before taking the root

Row's title names the city -> no rejecti.why: written against the first wording of the rule; after the fix above the spec says the city must be in both titles, and a single posting in Pensacola for a Sunrise row is another opening → null

detect_ats_brassring_query_with_partneri.why: fixed: the "#Home" fragment was kept in the ident; the BrassRing pattern now stops at "#"

brassring_session_token_and_entity_decod.why: fixed: the hidden inputs were matched only with name/id before type; attributes are now read in any order

parse_brassring_location_question_and_li.why: the case puts "jobtitle" on the job object, beside Questions; the spec (and the live BrassRing answer: Questions[] holds QuestionName "jobtitle") takes the title from the Questions dict, so a job whose Questions have no jobtitle has no title and is skipped → []

parse_brassring_skips_jobs_without_link_.why: the case puts "jobtitle" on the job object, beside Questions; the spec (and the live BrassRing answer: Questions[] holds QuestionName "jobtitle") takes the title from the Questions dict, so a job whose Questions have no jobtitle has no title and is skipped → []

parse_dover url-quotes name, joins locat.why: the case puts the locations under "location"; Dover's careers-page JSON (read live 2026-11-03, Diffuse Bio) names the list "locations", and the spec now says so — the first wording only said "each location's name"

parse_dover skips unpublished and sample.why: the case puts the locations under "location"; Dover's careers-page JSON (read live 2026-11-03, Diffuse Bio) names the list "locations", and the spec now says so — the first wording only said "each location's name"

rmk_site returns [] on a vendor jobs2web.why: fixed: rmk_site checked only the vendor domains; it now refuses every host site_hosts would not try (vendor-label jobs2web hosts such as careers.jobs2web.com too), as the spec says

parse gem with extId and id fallback.why: fixed (JSA-137): a remote Gem location with a city but no name came back as "Remote"; the city is the more useful value (the matcher checks the city), so name → city → "Remote" is the order now; spec reworded
